fields.Name: StartTour
fields.Description: Start a Guided Tour for the user by TourKey in Visual, Chat, or Voice guide mode, optionally jumping to a specific step key.
fields.InputSchemaJSON: {"type":"object","properties":{"TourKey":{"type":"string","description":"Stable TourKey of the tour to launch (e.g., 'core.welcome', 'core.records')"},"Mode":{"type":"string","enum":["Visual","Chat","Voice"],"description":"Guide mode (defaults to the tour's DefaultGuideMode or Visual)"},"StartAtStepKey":{"type":"string","description":"Optional step key within the tour to start at"}},"required":["TourKey"]}

fields.Name: ListTours
fields.Description: List active Guided Tours available to the current user, optionally filtered to the user's current screen location or a text search query.
fields.InputSchemaJSON: {"type":"object","properties":{"ForCurrentLocation":{"type":"boolean","description":"When true, restrict to tours matching the user's current app or open record"},"Query":{"type":"string","description":"Optional search text matching tour name, description, or step titles"}}}

fields.Name: GetActiveTour
fields.Description: Return the currently active Guided Tour run state, current step details, completed step keys, and progress summary.

fields.Name: PauseTour
fields.Description: Pause or snooze the currently running Guided Tour while preserving progress so the user can resume later.

fields.Name: ResumeTour
fields.Description: Resume the user's paused or most recent in-progress Guided Tour from the current step.
fields.InputSchemaJSON: {"type":"object","properties":{"TourKey":{"type":"string","description":"Optional TourKey to resume if multiple paused runs exist"}}}

fields.Name: StopTour
fields.Description: Dismiss and close the currently active Guided Tour session.
